Describe the change and why it's useful.

Closes #

- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the pull request focused on one topic.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated the documentation and the `Unreleased` section of `CHANGELOG.md`
      for user-visible changes.
- [ ] The lint, format, and test checks pass locally.
- [ ] No login cookie, token, or personal music path is in the diff.
- [ ] I used a Conventional Commit-style title or commits.
